idea-plugin.name: Terminal AI Watcher
idea-plugin.description:
Monitors Android Studio's built-in terminal for AI CLI tool events (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) and sends IDE notifications with system sounds.

macOS: To receive system notification banners, allow notifications for your IDE in System Settings → Notifications. (In-IDE balloon notifications work without this.)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • New: Windows 10/11 support — native notifications, taskbar attention, and sound playback
  • New: Per-tab notification routing — alerts are accurately attributed to the originating terminal tab, even when multiple tabs or IDE windows are open
  • New: OS-aware settings UI — labels, sound options, and defaults adapt to the current operating system
  • Improve: Notification readability — project and tab info shown as a separate subtitle line
  • Improve: Hook configurations migrate automatically when upgrading from older versions
  • Improve: Marketplace verifier friendly — no external native library dependencies
